judge.method: viewed the Chrome render plus 2x crops of detail regions; strict per-requirement pass/fail

requirements.text: Create a classic rubber ducky shape with a distinct body and head, colored bright yellow.
The duck must have an orange beak and a simple black dot for an eye.
Draw a white, claw-foot bathtub shape, showing the inside view with a visible rim.
requirements.note: The tub is a white rounded-rectangle basin resting flat on the floor with only a soft drop shadow beneath it. It has no feet at all, let alone claw feet.

requirements.text: Fill the lower portion of the bathtub with light blue water.
Ensure the water line is clearly visible across the duck's body, showing the lower third of the duck submerged.
requirements.note: The duck's whole silhouette is drawn complete and unbroken above the surface, with a dark shadow ellipse beneath it; the water line does not cross the body anywhere and nothing is submerged.

requirements.text: Position the duck so it is floating on the water's surface, creating small, concentric circular ripples in the water around its base.
requirements.note: There are two long horizontal wavy strokes spanning the entire tub and a dark shadow ellipse under the duck, but no concentric circular ripples radiating from its base.

requirements.text: Depict soap bubbles as clusters of overlapping circles with a slight iridescence, using semi-transparent white, light pink, and light blue fills.
requirements.note: All bubbles are white circles with a white outer glow; there is not a single pink pixel anywhere in the render, so the light pink fill is absent.

requirements.text: Place a small cluster of bubbles on top of the duck's head.
requirements.note: No bubbles are drawn on the duck's head.

requirements.text: Place a large pile of bubbles against one side of the tub and a few floating on the water's surface around the duck.
requirements.note: The bubbles are four similar small clusters of about six circles each, spread symmetrically around the basin; the largest spans 19% of the tub width and none is banked into a large pile against one side.
